documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The 2Nd Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited reported a strong start to FY27 with Q1 revenue of INR 1,364 crore, representing a 33% year-on-year growth and an EBITDA margin of 15.1%. Management highlighted robust demand across vehicle segments, a healthy order book of INR 1,600 crore, and ongoing expansion projects including a mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar and a new Greenfuel facility in Nashik. The company maintains its long-term '20.20.20.20 Vision' targeting a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031. Management also discussed strategic entries into intelligent and connected vehicle components such as BCM, telematics, and ADAS capabilities. Management reported a record financial and operational performance for FY 26, achieving a highest-ever consolidated revenue of INR 4,870 crore and an EBITDA of INR 705 crore with a 14.5% margin.

guidance.claim: Management expects to be able to sustain the current Q1 margins for the remaining part of the year.
guidance.quote: On the margin front, I think I can only say that we will be able to sustain these current margins achieved in Q1 for the remaining part of the year as well.

guidance.claim: The full-year capex guidance continues to remain around INR 300 crore.
guidance.quote: The guidance for the full year continues to remain around INR 300 crore, which will include the upcoming greenfield expansions of Mechatronics as well as new plants of IAC division.

guidance.claim: Management states the effective tax rate is expected to hold at similar levels going forward.
guidance.quote: The effective tax rate continues to remain at around 25%, which is also expected to hold at similar levels way forward.

guidance.claim: The share of minority interest is expected to remain in the 11-13% range going forward.
guidance.quote: Going forward, this minority interest will remain in similar range between 11-13%-odd, considering the existing structure which is at the present moment.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its long-term 20% revenue CAGR target from 2025 to 2031.
guidance.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our “20.20.20.20 Vision”, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.

guidance.claim: Management is confident in posting double-digit growth for the remaining part of the year in the Aftermarket segment.
guidance.quote: However, we are confident to bounce back and confident to post double-digit growth for the remaining part of the year in this particular segment.

guidance.claim: Management remains on par with the mid-term strategy of a 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: So overall, I think we continue to be on par with the mid-term strategy of our 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.

guidance.claim: Full year margins should sustain or further improve by at least 30 bps.
guidance.quote: So for the full year, I do not foresee any reason that the margins would get negatively impacted. On the contrary, I would say, on account of the top line growth, the margin should just sustain or at least further go up by at least 30 bps or so.

guidance.claim: Effective tax rate for FY 26 is 26%, and management expects it to hold at similar levels going forward.
guidance.quote: Excluding the same, the effective tax rate for FY 26 comes out as 26%, and we expect it to hold at similar levels way forward.

guidance.claim: Minority share for FY 26 is at 17%, which is expected to be in a similar range going forward.
guidance.quote: The minority share for FY 26, however, is at 17%, and which is expected to be in a similar range going forward.

guidance.claim: FY 27 guidance for Lumax Ituran projects up to 150 basis points EBITDA improvement internally.
guidance.quote: However, the FY 27 guidance remains in place for up to 150 basis points improvement as is being projected internally right now.

demand_outlook.claim: As the company enters the festive season, demand is expected to remain healthy with low inventory levels reported by OEMs.
demand_outlook.quote: As we enter the festive season, demand is expected to remain healthy, with many leading OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers) reporting low inventory levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry growth rates are expected to reduce significantly in Q3 and Q4 compared to the previous year's hyper-growth base.
demand_outlook.quote: However, as we get into Q3 and Q4, for overall as an industry, the growth rates will reduce significantly because last year, post the GST rationalization, H2 was really a very hyper-growth already delivered.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from a retail point of view continues to remain intact.
demand_outlook.quote: However, of course, there are certain input costs and margin pressures. But the demand from a retail point of view, still seems to be intact.

demand_outlook.claim: CNG continues to have a very strong pull in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: So CNG continues to have a very strong pull in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall demand environment and industry outlook continue to be favourable going into FY 27.
demand_outlook.quote: In closing, while we remain watchful of the macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation and the energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favourable, giving us confidence as we enter FY 27.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant at Chakan is being set up for the IAC division to cater to upcoming demand from Mahindra & Mahindra.
capex_expansion.quote: • A new plant at Chakan for the IAC division to cater to upcoming demand from Mahindra & Mahindra, while simultaneously optimizing product lines between this facility and the existing ones.

capex_expansion.claim: The mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, Haryana is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: • The previously announced mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, Haryana is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of this year, where we are consolidating four entities, Lumax Yokowo, Lumax Alps Alpine, Lumax Ituran and Lumax FAE, under one roof to optimize resources and fixed costs.

capex_expansion.claim: A new facility is being set up in Nashik to cater to Mahindra's requirements after onboarding them as a new customer at Greenfuel Energy.
capex_expansion.quote: • At Greenfuel Energy, we are pleased to report that we onboarded Mahindra as a new customer and to cater to their requirements, we shall be setting up a new facility in Nashik.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex during the first quarter stood at INR 23 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex during the 1st Quarter was INR 23 crore.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex during the year was INR 233 crore, including strategic investments in land in Gujarat and Kharkhoda Region.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex during the year was INR 233 crore, which included strategic investment in land in Gujarat and Kharkhoda Region of INR 45 crore and also almost INR 100 crore on capacity expansions in IAC and Lumax Alps Alpine.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the sale of the entire 50% equity stake in Lumax JOPP Allied Technologies Private Limited to JOPP Holding Germany.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has also approved the sale of entire 50% equity stake in Lumax JOPP Allied Technologies Private Limited to JOPP Holding Germany, the Joint Venture partner, subject to completion of customary conditions in terms of the share purchase agreement.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved a proposal to acquire the remaining 15.97% stake in Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited from its existing shareholders.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has also approved proposal to acquire the remaining stake of 15.97% in Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited, from its existing shareholders.

margins_costs.claim: For plastics, the company typically has a back-to-back arrangement with 80% to 90% of OEMs realizing price changes within the same quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Only for few OEMs, maybe the spillover happens to the next quarter. But I would say to a great extent of 80% to 90%, we get the realization within the same quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Short-term margin pressure exists due to inflationary costs in raw materials, manpower, and energy.
margins_costs.quote: So Amit, most of the inflationary costs, be it on account of raw material commodities or also the manpower cost, which has significantly risen up due to certain minimum wage hikes, also the energy price is going up, all of it has, of course, put some short-term pressure on the margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company has back-to-back understandings with OEMs and expects to recover inflationary cost increases with a lag of 3 to 6 months.
margins_costs.quote: But more or less, all of it, we actually have a back-to-back understanding with the OEMs. It is just a lag of about 3 to 6 months depending on the OEM by when we get these realizations.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported an order book of INR 1,600 crore, with 24% executable in FY27, 56% in FY28, and 20% in FY29.
orders_capacity.quote: We are pleased to report a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore, which provides a healthy visibility for the business going forward. Of this order book, approximately 24% is expected to be executed in this FY 27 itself, 56% in FY 28, and the remaining 20% in FY 29.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book for the Advanced Plastics division stands strong at INR 787 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book remains strong at INR 787 crore for this division, providing solid future visibility.

orders_capacity.claim: The Mechatronics segment has a healthy order book close to INR 500 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Mechatronics segment sustained its upward momentum, delivering a y-o-y increase of almost 56% in Q1 FY 27 from INR 54 to INR 84 crore, with a very healthy order book of close to INR 500 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The Structure and Control Systems vertical reported an order book of INR 130 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: It reported a y-o-y growth of 21% in Q1, increasing from INR 180 crore to INR 220 crore with an order book of INR 130 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The Alternate Fuels business showed an order book of INR 200 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Alternate Fuels business showed a growth of 17% y-o-y from INR 95 to INR 111 crore with an order book of INR 200 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book stands at a robust INR 1,450 crore, providing healthy visibility.
orders_capacity.quote: Coming to the order book, we are pleased to report a robust order book of INR 1,450 crore, which provides healthy visibility for the business going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: Of the order book, approximately 25% is expected to be executed in FY 27, 54% in FY 28, and 21% in FY 29.
orders_capacity.quote: Of this order book, approximately 25% is expected to be executed in this financial year FY 27, 54% in FY 28 and the remaining 21% in FY 29.

orders_capacity.claim: Advanced plastics contribute the largest share of the order book, followed by Mechatronics, alternate fuels, and Structures & Control Systems.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book continues to reflect a healthy traction across all our product verticals with advanced plastics contributing the largest share, followed by Mechatronics, alternate fuels and Structures & Control Systems.

orders_capacity.claim: Mechatronics segment grew 150% in FY 26 to INR 281 crore with an order book of INR 400 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Mechatronics segment sustained upward momentum, delivering a y-o-y growth of almost 150% in FY 26 from INR 115 crore to INR 281 crore with a healthy order book of INR 400 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Structures & Control Systems vertical reported revenues of INR 816 crore with an order book of INR 170 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: It reported a y-o-y growth of 17% in FY 26, increasing from INR 693 crore to INR 816 crore. With an order book of INR 170 crore, this strengthens our position as a trusted technology partner in the evolving mobility ecosystem.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term debt stood at INR 508 crore, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.32.
capital_allocation.quote: The long-term debt stood at INR 508 crore, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.32, which is within our internal comfort thresholds.

capital_allocation.claim: The majority of the INR 300 crore capex will continue to be funded from internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The majority of the capex, INR 300 crore, will continue to fund from the internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 396 crore as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash reserves stood at INR 396 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains an internal policy of a minimum 35% dividend payout ratio.
capital_allocation.quote: So the payout ratio, we have a very fair internal policy of maintaining a minimum 35% payout ratio and the Company continues to maintain that for the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the global economy continues to navigate a challenging geopolitical landscape with ongoing conflict in the Middle East and energy security concerns.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economy continues to navigate a challenging geopolitical landscape with the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, heightening concerns around energy security, supply chain disruptions, and inflationary pressures.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry continues to closely monitor commodity prices, geopolitical developments, and supply chain dynamics.
risks_headwinds.quote: The industry continues to closely monitor commodity prices, geopolitical developments and supply chain dynamics that could influence input costs and overall market sentiment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains watchful of macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation, and energy price volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: In closing, while we remain watchful of the macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation and the energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favourable, giving us confidence as we enter FY 27.

management_commitments.claim: By FY 2031, the company aspires to more than double its current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore.
management_commitments.quote: And by FY 2031, we aspire to more than double our current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore, fueled by a blend of organic excellence and strategically inorganic opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to inch closer to a 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.
management_commitments.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our “20.20.20.20 Vision”, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.

management_commitments.claim: The Mechatronics division expects to reach close to INR 1,000 crore top line by FY 2030-31.
management_commitments.quote: I think, to me, by FY 2030-31, we should definitely be looking at close to INR 1,000 crore top line from Mechatronics division.

management_commitments.claim: The Mechatronics basket will be operating anywhere between 14-15% EBITDA over the next 12-24 months.
management_commitments.quote: the intended path is that over the next 12-24 months, the Mechatronics basket will be operating in anywhere between 14-15% EBITDA.

management_commitments.claim: Certain joint ventures are expected to move into a permanent PBT double-digit positive category in the next 12 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: We see these couple of joint ventures, which are currently EBITDA positive, moving into a permanent PBT double-digit positive category, perhaps, maybe in the next 12 to 24 months once we reach scale.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve a 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years as part of its mid-term strategy.
management_commitments.quote: So overall, I think we continue to be on par with the mid-term strategy of our 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: Full-year margins are expected to sustain or increase by at least 30 bps.
management_commitments.quote: On the contrary, I would say, on account of the top line growth, the margin should just sustain or at least further go up by at least 30 bps or so.

management_commitments.claim: Effective tax rate is expected to hold at around 26% going forward.
management_commitments.quote: Excluding the same, the effective tax rate for FY 26 comes out as 26%, and we expect it to hold at similar levels way forward.

management_commitments.claim: Minority share is expected to remain in the 15% to 17% range going forward.
management_commitments.quote: The minority share for FY 26, however, is at 17%, and which is expected to be in a similar range going forward.

management_commitments.claim: Repayment of acquisition-related long-term debt starts fully from this year onwards, with current debt loans automatically dying down over the next 3 to 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: And accordingly, their repayment or I would say, the full repayment is starting from this year onwards. And considering the balance payment, I think in next 3 to 4 years, I think the current levels of debt or the loan which is there will automatically die down.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
